issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one accepted AWS CloudFormation retirement decision for the bounded template denominator.

## Primary deliverable

One accepted retirement ledger for the issue-specific CloudFormation templates and every active or planned consumer.

## Verification result

Template, consumer, parity, Terraform replacement, rollback, retained-evidence, and live-stack checks produce one disposition per bounded template with no dual ownership.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one accepted retirement decision; template translations and qualification runs are evidence inputs or separately reviewable follow-up work.

## Dependencies

- AWS-F: #489
- XCL-01: #495

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Issue 194 and 268 templates are inventoried
- [ ] Every consumer and retained evidence path has a disposition
- [ ] Retirement requires proven Terraform parity and rollback
- [ ] No active stack is silently abandoned

## Owned paths

- `infra/aws/runtime/**`
- `adl/tools/issue194_private_network.cloudformation.json`
- `adl/tools/issue268_runtime_qualification.cloudformation.yaml`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/aws-g/**`

## PVF lanes

- `template-denominator`
- `consumer-census`
- `parity-and-rollback`
- `live-stack-readback`
- `retirement-decision`

## Stop conditions

- A consumer is unclassified
- A live stack owner is ambiguous
- Terraform parity is absent

## Non-goals

- Deleting historical evidence
- Forced retirement
- Website Terraform changes

## Canonical planning identity

- Planned ID: `AWS-G`
- Canonical title: `[v0.92.1][AWS-G] AWS CloudFormation retirement decision`
